messages:
maria: Execs want SSO in MVP; per-tenant routing and routing analytics -> v1. quick scope sync?

sam: agree. keep SSO + KMS + audit logs. remove routing UI for MVP.

taylor: cutting UI saves frontend+infra work. will add flag to keep API hooks.

priya: security: KMS + audit logs stay. booked compliance review 2026-06-07.

jen: ops: need fallback toggle and updated rollback steps. will patch playbook.

maria: proposed dates: internal alpha 2026-06-16, public pilot 2026-06-23, canary 2026-06-23->06-27.

sam: add tiny telemetry: `routing_ui_attempt` and `routing_request_click` to measure demand.

priya: noted. ensure rotation proof in review.

release-bot: canary_window set 2026-06-23 -> 2026-06-27; rollback on error_rate>4% or p95>500ms.

maria: action items: @taylor remove UI; @priya confirm compliance slot; @jen update playbook; @maria draft customer comms. thanks :v:
_meta: short slack thread about cutting routing UI from SSO MVP and shifting milestone
